pages.intro: Choose Chin Threading when you want precise removal of visible chin hair without wax.
pages.best_for: Clients who prefer thread-based facial hair removal on one focused area.

focus.title: Focused Chin Precision
focus.text: Threading targets individual rows of hair across the chin area.

focus.title: No Wax Product
focus.text: Hair is removed with thread, without applying wax to the skin.

pages.intro: Choose Upper Lip Threading when you want precise removal of visible hair above the lip without wax.
pages.best_for: Clients who prefer a quick thread-based option for this small facial area.

focus.title: Upper-Lip Precision
focus.text: Threading targets the narrow upper-lip area with controlled movements.

focus.title: Clean Product-Free Method
focus.text: The technique uses thread rather than wax or depilatory products.

pages.intro: Choose Lower Lip Threading when fine visible hair below the lip needs precise, wax-free removal.
pages.best_for: Clients treating the small lower-lip area separately from a full-face service.

focus.title: Small-Area Accuracy
focus.text: Threading gives controlled access to fine hair around the lower-lip area.

focus.title: Thread-Only Technique
focus.text: No wax product is applied during the hair-removal process.

pages.intro: Choose Neck Threading when visible fine hair around the neck needs a clean, defined finish without wax.
pages.best_for: Clients wanting focused thread-based grooming below the jaw or around the neckline.

focus.title: Defined Neckline
focus.text: Threading follows the agreed neck area for a tidier visible outline.

focus.title: Wax-Free Hair Removal
focus.text: The service uses thread rather than applying wax across the neck.

pages.intro: Choose Forehead Threading when fine hair around the forehead or hairline needs precise cleanup.
pages.best_for: Clients wanting a cleaner forehead outline without booking a full-face threading service.

focus.title: Hairline-Area Control
focus.text: Threading removes visible fine hair while respecting the agreed forehead outline.

focus.title: Focused Single Area
focus.text: Only the forehead zone is treated for a quick, specific appointment.

pages.intro: Choose Side Locks Threading when facial side areas need precise cleanup and a more defined outline.
pages.best_for: Clients wanting thread-based grooming along the side-lock area without full-face treatment.

focus.title: Side-Area Definition
focus.text: Threading follows the agreed side-lock line for a tidy, balanced result.

focus.title: Controlled Symmetry
focus.text: Both sides are checked together to support an even-looking outline.

pages.intro: Choose Eyebrows Threading when brows need precise cleanup, definition, or reshaping without wax.
pages.best_for: Clients who prefer thread-based brow grooming with close control around the shape.

focus.title: Shape Agreed First
focus.text: Your preferred brow thickness and outline are discussed before threading begins.

focus.title: Precise Hair Removal
focus.text: Threading removes fine rows of hair for a clean, defined brow edge.

pages.intro: Choose Full Face Threading when several facial areas need thread-based hair removal in one appointment.
pages.best_for: Clients wanting broader facial coverage with the choice to include or exclude eyebrow shaping.

focus.title: With or Without Eyebrows
focus.text: Select the package that matches whether brow shaping is part of the service.

focus.title: Coordinated Face Coverage
focus.text: Multiple agreed facial areas are completed within one organised appointment.
